newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa ends lower, as weak tone continues.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa ends lower, as weak tone continues.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures ended weaker and toward the day's lows on Tuesday, pressured by a late-session round of light speculative and trade selling, floor sources said.
March futures ended $6 a tonne weaker, at $1,356, having ranged from $1,368 to $1,355. May fell $6, to $1,380, while the rest closed $4 to $6 lower.
With prices finishing lower for the fourth consecutive session, traders said the market's technical outlook appeared weak.
"There has been an erosion in prices," one trader said. "If (March) trades under $1,350 it looks very bad."
Traders said March may need to test a recent low of $1,342 before substantial buying interest emerges.
Dealers said switch activity accounted for the bulk of the day's estimated 7,007-lot volume, with traders focused on the March/July switch.
"It was very slow in outright volume," one trader said. "There were about 3,000 lots of March/July traded." ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities +1 212 859 1640))
